data.body: VERIFICATION_PLAN_REVISED 2026-05-24: Success Criteria + Closure Checks rewritten with in-session analogs replacing time-based requirements (7d/30d/2-week soaks). Analog summary: (1) absence-of-runs check (CC1) replaces 7d soak with deterministic structural check post-merge; (2) 5 consecutive workflow_dispatch runs (CC3) replaces 30d failure-rate-<1% with 100% green over 5 sequential passes; (3) 2 consecutive on-demand weekly-fsck cycles replaces 2-week soak; (4) 5-pass REST budget observation replaces 7d 429-free window; (5) BRIDGE_ENV_ID removed from forbidden-refs list because reconciler legitimately consumes it. SC1+SC5+SC6 already lacked time component, just need live execution. SC2/SC4 collapsed to 3 sequential workflow_dispatch runs. SC3 = 2-pass JQL cross-reference. SC7 already satisfied via 7339 user-override 2026-05-24. All verification will execute in current session via live reconcile-bridge.yml + DIG Jira + drift harness + on-demand fsck.
